96

 Thanks, Sara! 
Last week, I sent out a one-question survey and the answers were more surprising than I expected.
So thank you for giving me your insights. I realized a lot of people are getting mixed messages and are frustrated with the process of buying a firm.
Buying a firm doesn’t have to be this way. 
And you can absolutely make sense of the process with the right information.
I wanted to share with you our Weekly Wine Down episodes to help you get started on that. 
I know you and I both want focused support on buying a firm, and I hope this helps you get started and feeling confident about it.
Best,
Sara Sharp
Deal Attorney, Partner
SK&S Law Group
PS. Curious about that one-question survey? I’d love for you to take 60 seconds and tell me your thoughts right here.
